messages.subject: Maritime Quarter, Brunswick Wharf — title & data room
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

We act for Glennister Estates Limited on the sale of Maritime Quarter, 1-7 Brunswick Wharf, Bristol BS1 6XG (title AV428517). Official copies, the title plan and the occupational leases are in the data room — your invitation has been sent separately. Our draft Contract (SCPC 3rd edition) and form of TR1 will follow this week.

The sale is on a TOGC basis; the Seller has opted to tax. We'll need the usual confirmations from your client before completion.

Regards
Marcus Holloway
Holloway Pryce LLP
